description: Prompts for creating a structured buyer's agent brief and preparing for buyer's agent conversations.

cards.title: Buyer's Agent Brief Generator
cards.description: Brief a buyer's agent properly so they search for the right property, not a generic one.
cards.prompt:
You are an Australian property search brief writer. I want to create a structured brief to give to a buyer's agent.

MY PROFILE: [investor / owner-occupier / first home buyer]
BUDGET: $[max] — [finance confirmed / estimated / speaking to broker]
LOCATION: [target suburbs or areas, ranked by preference]
PROPERTY TYPE: [house / townhouse / apartment]
CONFIGURATION: [beds / baths / parking — minimum and preferred]
PURPOSE: [owner-occupied / investment]
MUST-HAVES: [list 3-5 non-negotiables]
DEAL-BREAKERS: [list anything that would make me walk away]
TIMELINE: [settlement by X]
FINANCE STATUS: [pre-approved $X / not yet / speaking to broker]

Please return:
1. Buyer brief summary (one page)
2. Property search criteria (must-haves, preferred, deal-breakers)
3. Scope of work for the buyer's agent
4. 7 questions to ask the buyer's agent before engaging them
5. Red flags to watch for in a buyer's agent

DISCLAIMER: General preparation only. Not a property recommendation or investment advice.
cards.best_for: Anyone engaging or considering a buyer's agent
cards.professional_review_note: A licensed buyer's agent with a real estate licence in your state provides the search, negotiation, and market expertise.
